FOREIGN_BYTES.doc: Target byte representations independent of the SML host's widths.

members.name: Error
members.doc: Invalid widths, malformed byte counts or out-of-range values.

members.name: integer
members.spec: val integer : {width : int, signed : bool, littleEndian : bool, value : IntInf.int} -> string

members.name: value
members.spec: val value : {signed : bool, littleEndian : bool, bytes : string} -> IntInf.int
members.doc:
`value {signed, littleEndian, bytes}` decodes a bounded integer object.

**Raises** `Error` unless the string contains one through sixteen bytes.

members.name: real64
members.spec: val real64 : {littleEndian : bool, value : real} -> string
members.doc:
`real64 {littleEndian, value}` encodes an IEEE binary64 object.

**Raises** `Error` when the host's default SML real has another width.

members.name: real64Value
members.spec: val real64Value : {littleEndian : bool, bytes : string} -> real
members.doc:
`real64Value {littleEndian, bytes}` decodes exactly eight bytes.

**Raises** `Error` for another byte count.

members.name: real32
members.spec: val real32 : {littleEndian : bool, value : real} -> string
members.doc:
`real32 {littleEndian, value}` rounds binary64 to IEEE binary32 bytes.

Rounding is to nearest, ties to even. Overflow produces signed infinity;
NaNs use a canonical quiet payload. This is independent of the C process
floating-point rounding mode.

members.name: real32Value
members.spec: val real32Value : {littleEndian : bool, bytes : string} -> real
members.doc:
`real32Value {littleEndian, bytes}` widens an IEEE binary32 object exactly.

**Raises** `Error` unless exactly four bytes are supplied.

FOREIGN_SCOPE.doc: Deterministic foreign cleanup on normal and exceptional SML returns.

members.name: scope
members.doc: One dynamically scoped collection of cleanup actions.

members.name: ticket
members.doc: An armed cleanup action, independent of a native address.

members.name: withScope
members.doc:
`withScope body` runs registered actions in reverse registration order.

Every armed action is attempted once. A body exception takes priority
over cleanup exceptions; otherwise the first cleanup exception escapes.

members.name: defer
members.doc:
`defer (scope, action)` registers an action before its resource escapes.

**Raises** `Closed` when the scope is closing or closed.

members.name: run
members.doc: `run ticket` attempts its action now, at most once, even if it raises.

members.name: cancel
members.doc: `cancel ticket` transfers cleanup responsibility to the caller.

FOREIGN_TEXT.doc: Explicit foreign text boundaries with preserved Windows code units.

members.name: encoding
members.spec: datatype encoding = Bytes | Utf8 | Wtf8 | Utf16
members.doc: Bytes are uninterpreted; UTF-16 consumes and produces WTF-8 SML text.

members.name: Error
members.spec: exception Error of {offset : int, message : string}
members.doc: A byte position and the reason conversion cannot satisfy its policy.

members.name: encode
members.spec: val encode : {encoding : encoding, littleEndian : bool, terminated : bool, text : string} -> string
members.doc:
`encode {encoding, littleEndian, terminated, text}` copies native text.

UTF-8 is strict. WTF-8 permits lone surrogates; UTF-16 preserves them.
Terminated text rejects embedded NUL and appends a native terminator.

members.name: decode
members.spec: val decode : {encoding : encoding, littleEndian : bool, terminated : bool, bytes : string} -> string
members.doc:
`decode {encoding, littleEndian, terminated, bytes}` reads bounded text.

Terminated input must contain a terminator within these bytes. UTF-16
pairs become scalar UTF-8; lone surrogate code units remain WTF-8.
Odd UTF-16 byte counts and malformed UTF-8/WTF-8 raise `Error`.
